# package mrp

```go
import "github.com/otfabric/go-profinet/mrp"
```

Package mrp encodes and decodes the frames of the Media Redundancy Protocol (IEC 62439-2) that PROFINET rings use: MRP\_Test, MRP\_TopologyChange, MRP\_LinkDown and MRP\_LinkUp with MRP\_Common and MRP\_Option. The layouts are those of Wireshark's MRP dissector, the Linux kernel's MRP UAPI header and microchip-ung/mrp (docs/research/EVIDENCE-MRP-PTCP-MGMT.md, A.1). It has no state machine: it is the codec a ring manager or client is built on, and it lets tools read the MRP traffic of a ring.

```go
	StatePT      = "PT"       // client: the second port came up, blocked
```

The profiles of microchip-ung/mrp and umrp (UNVERIFIED against IEC 62439-2). The 30 ms and 10 ms profiles need timers a general-purpose OS does not keep; they are not offered.

```go
var (
	// MACTest receives MRP_Test frames.
	MACTest = ethernet.MAC{0x01, 0x15, 0x4E, 0x00, 0x00, 0x01}
	// MACControl receives MRP_TopologyChange, MRP_LinkDown and MRP_LinkUp.
	MACControl = ethernet.MAC{0x01, 0x15, 0x4E, 0x00, 0x00, 0x02}
	// MACInTest and MACInControl are the interconnection counterparts.
	MACInTest    = ethernet.MAC{0x01, 0x15, 0x4E, 0x00, 0x00, 0x03}
	MACInControl = ethernet.MAC{0x01, 0x15, 0x4E, 0x00, 0x00, 0x04}
)
```

## Functions

### func Better

```go
func Better(p uint16, a ethernet.MAC, q uint16, b ethernet.MAC) bool
```

Better reports whether a manager of priority p and address a beats one of q and b: the lower priority, then the lower address.

Common is MRP\_Common: the sequence number and the domain.

### type Config

```go
type Config struct {
	Role Role
	// Ports are the muxes of the two ring ports' local ports (frames to
	// the MRP groups arrive there; frames sent there leave on that port),
	// the primary first; Index their port numbers in Switch.
	Ports [2]*l2.Mux
	Index [2]int
	// Switch blocks and flushes; required.
	Switch Switch
	// MAC is the MRP_SA, the switch's (interface) MAC address; required.
	MAC ethernet.MAC
	// Domain is the MRP domain UUID; zero means DefaultDomain.
	Domain [16]byte
	// Prio is the manager priority; zero means DefaultManagerPrio
	// (DefaultAutoPrio for RoleAuto).
	Prio uint16
	// Profile is the timer profile; zero means Profile200.
	Profile Profile
	// OnChange is called after the ring state or a port state changed,
	// never with the entity's lock held; it must not block.
	OnChange func()
	Logger   profinet.Logger
}
```

Config configures an entity.

### type Entity

```go
type Entity struct {

	// acting is RoleManager or RoleClient: an automatic manager changes
	// it; ringMAC and ringPrio are the manager it gave way to, and
	// monitorMisses counts the test intervals without a test of a better
	// manager.

	// linkTimer is the client's wait for a TopologyChange after a port
	// came up; it unblocks the port when it runs out.

	// linkGen numbers a client's link changes: a burst of link change
	// frames stops when a newer change starts, so that a LinkDown is
	// never repeated after the link came back.

	// testNow asks the manager's loop for a test round now.

}
```

Entity is a running MRP client or manager.

### type Frame

```go
type Frame struct {
	Version        uint16
	Test           *Test
	TopologyChange *TopologyChange
	Link           *LinkChange
	Common         *Common
	Options        []Option
	Other          []TLV
}
```

Frame is an MRP PDU (after the Ethernet header).

#### func Decode

```go
func Decode(b []byte) (Frame, error)
```

Decode decodes an MRP PDU (after the Ethernet header). It accepts TLVs with and without the padding to four octets (Wireshark's layout and microchip-ung/mrp's differ for MRP\_LinkDown/Up) and ignores what follows MRP\_End (the Ethernet padding).

#### func (Frame) AppendTo

```go
func (f *Frame) AppendTo(b []byte) ([]byte, error)
```

AppendTo appends the encoded PDU: MRP\_Version, the frame's TLV (MRP\_Test, MRP\_TopologyChange or a link change), its options and other TLVs, MRP\_Common and MRP\_End.

### type ManagerOption

```go
type ManagerOption struct {
	Type      SubType
	Prio      uint16
	SA        ethernet.MAC
	OtherPrio uint16
	OtherSA   ethernet.MAC
}
```

ManagerOption is MRP\_TestMgrNAck (a manager tells another, OtherSA, to stop managing: it is the better one) or MRP\_TestPropagate (a manager that gave up announces the manager that won, Other\*).

### type Status

```go
type Status struct {
	Role Role
	// Acting is what the entity is now: RoleManager or RoleClient (an
	// automatic manager is either).
	Acting Role
	// Manager is the better manager an automatic manager acting as a
	// client follows (zero otherwise), ManagerPrio its priority.
	Manager     ethernet.MAC
	ManagerPrio uint16
	State       string
```
